notes: Genre: Action. Live values from RA notes, not checked in a running game unless said. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text: Red and Blue play the same stages with different weapon sets and scenes.
widgets.label: Heroes

widgets.text: A jump, B shoot, R switch weapon, L slide; B near enemies = melee/throw
widgets.label: Controls

widgets.text:
Force (rapid shots), Lightning (piercing beam), Fire (short flame).
Each has a special attack using the special gauge.
widgets.label: Three weapons

widgets.text:
Melee throws do big damage up close.
Switch to Lightning against armoured bosses.
The Seven Force returns: learn each form.
widgets.label: Tips

widgets.text: Episodes based on the original Gunstar Heroes, including the dice-board Black's stage and a ship shooter stage.
widgets.label: Structure

widgets.text: Hitting enemies fills the gauge for the special attack.
widgets.label: Special gauge

widgets.text: Each hero sees different scenes: clear the game with both.
widgets.label: Secrets

widgets.text: Finish the episodes with both heroes for the full story.
widgets.label: Goal
